# A synthetic console dump of a Pi 5 where the probe could read the HVS but
# not two other blocks: pixelvalve0 and pixelvalve1 were not mapped, and the
# HDMI's HSM clock was answered 0, so the hd region was not read. Their table
# words are 0xffffffff - main.c's rule, and its own NOT mapped / NOT read
# lines name each block. The HVS's own words are read and its channels are
# idle (no list installed, no valve judged running).

rpi5_display: build test
rpi5_display: mailbox init 0
rpi5_display: the hdmi0 hd region is NOT read: the hdmi clock (HSM, clock id 13) it was answered 0, and an HDMI register read with that clock at 0 or unknown is the documented silent CPU stall (rpi:vc4_hdmi.c:3251-3262)
rpi5_display: mapping pixelvalve0 at 0x107c410000, 256 bytes
rpi5_display: pixelvalve0 NOT mapped; every one of its words below reads 0xffffffff
rpi5_display: mapping pixelvalve1 at 0x107c411000, 256 bytes
rpi5_display: pixelvalve1 NOT mapped; every one of its words below reads 0xffffffff
